notes.title: Accessibility update
notes.content: [p]Based on your feedback, I've worked to add many accessibility features to the demo:     [/p][list][*][p]A Light Theme is now available for those of you who prefer to read dark text on a light background rather than the opposite[/p][/*][*][p]The game now automatically saves on Exit and after every choice [/p][/*][*][p]A "Resume" button was added to the main menu; it will load your latest save (either manual or automatic) [/p][/*][*][p]Font choices and font size choices are now available through the Settings menu  [/p][/*][*][p]Speaking of menus, the main menu has been revamped[/p][/*][*][p]New buttons have been added to the quick menu: Back, Skip, Auto: to rewind, skip previously read text, and auto-forward the text, respectively; Rewind and Skip can be activated with the mouse/keyboard with the scroll-wheel and the Ctrl/Cmd keys  [/p][/*][*][p]The game should now be fully playable with a controller, with the exception of the name input at the start of the game.[/p][/*][/list]
